instruction: Open the X app, tap the magnifier icon at the bottom, then tap the 'News' button at the top to browse the latest news. Next, open the Notes app, tap the plus icon to create a new note, and type or paste the news content. Finally, tap the share button in the note, select the WeChat icon, search for your friend 'xxoo', and tap send to share the note.
